result.topic_en: Gauss's calculations comparing the trapezoid and midpoint (tangent) rules for numerical integration via Taylor expansion error terms, followed by manipulations of series such as Leibniz-type series and partial-fraction rearrangements, and some continued-fraction-like expressions in α, β, γ.

methods.what: Taylor expansion of integrand to derive error of trapezoid-type rule (integral over [0,δ])
Error term of approximation stated as too small
Midpoint-rule expansion: integral from -1/2 to 1/2 of Taylor series yields odd powers with coefficients 1/(n·2^{n-1})
Acceleration of Leibniz-type series by subtracting shifted series and expressing remainder as hypergeometric series F
Termwise subtraction of harmonic series to obtain rapidly convergent series
Error estimates of truncated continued fractions
